caption: the luxor encore - a greatest-hits track pack that closed the mainline series.
about: Luxor: 5th Passage (2010) is the series' send-off: a track pack that remixes the best stages of the line with a handful of new mechanics and the usual power-ball toolbox. It plays as both encore and argument that the formula never needed saving - the chains still roll, the gap shot still decides everything.
The pc build is off the current stores, carried by archive routes. The mainline luxor line ends here - six entries, all documented in this catalogue.
